request.query: The coefficient of exponent d in the coefficient of X none to power n of an Option-variable multivariate polynomial equals its coefficient at d mapped along some plus single none n

items.informal_name: Coefficient Correspondence under Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Option Variables
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any natural number $ m $ and finite support function $ d : \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ d $ in the $ m $-th coefficient of the polynomial obtained via the algebra equivalence $ \text{optionEquivLeft} $ is equal to the coefficient of the monomial $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ in $ p $. Here, $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ denotes the monomial in $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ that maps $ \text{none} $ to $ m $ and $ \text{some}\, s $ to $ d(s) $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient correspondence in algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ n : \text{Option } \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $ and polynomial $ f \in R[\text{Option } \sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial corresponding to $ n $ restricted to $ \sigma $ in the polynomial obtained by evaluating the algebra equivalence at the variable corresponding to 'none' equals the coefficient of $ n $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_{n.\text{some}}(\text{Polynomial.coeff}(\text{optionEquivLeft}(f), n(\text{none}))) = \text{coeff}_n(f) $.

items.informal_name: Monomial Mapping under Option σ Algebra Equivalence
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) ((MvPolynomial.monomial m) r) =
    (Polynomial.monomial (m none)) ((MvPolynomial.monomial m.some) r)
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over $\text{Option } \sigma$ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients sends a monomial with exponents $m : \text{Option } \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N}$ and coefficient $r \in R$ to the product of a monomial in the outer polynomial ring with exponent $m(\text{none})$ and a monomial in the inner multivariate polynomial ring with exponents $m(\text{some } s)$ for $s \in \sigma$.

items.informal_name: Image of $ X_{\text{none}} $ under Option $ \sigma $ Polynomial Equivalence is $ X $
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R],
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X none) = Polynomial.X
items.informal_description: Under the algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\text{Option } \sigma] $ and the polynomial ring $ (R[\sigma])[X] $, the variable corresponding to $ \text{none} $ in $ \text{Option } \sigma $ is mapped to the indeterminate $ X $ of the outer polynomial ring.

items.informal_name: Image of 'none' variable under algebra equivalence is constant polynomial X
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R],
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X none) = MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X
items.informal_description: Under the algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomial rings with variables indexed by $\text{Option } S_1$ and those indexed by $S_1$ with coefficients in $R[X]$, the 'none' variable is mapped to the constant polynomial corresponding to the indeterminate $X$ in $R[X]$. This establishes that evaluating the 'none' variable through the equivalence yields the canonical embedding of $X$ as a constant polynomial.

items.informal_name: Coefficients of Homogeneous Polynomials under Option Equivalence are Homogeneous
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} [hσ : Finite σ] {p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ).symm p).IsHomogeneous n → ∀ (i j : ℕ), i + j = n → (p.coeff i).IsHomogeneous j
items.informal_description: Given a finite type $\sigma$ and a commutative semiring $R$, if the inverse image of a polynomial $p \in R[\text{Option } \sigma]$ under the algebra equivalence $\text{optionEquivLeft}$ is a homogeneous polynomial of degree $n$, then for all natural numbers $i, j$ satisfying $i + j = n$, the coefficient of $p$ at degree $i$ (viewed as a polynomial in the outer variable) is a homogeneous polynomial of degree $j$ in the inner multivariate polynomial ring $R[\sigma]$.

items.informal_name: Application of Algebra Equivalence for Optional Variables in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over $\text{Option } \sigma$ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients over $\sigma$ is defined by evaluating each variable in $\text{Option } \sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\text{none}$ case) or as the constant polynomial with coefficient corresponding to the variable in $\sigma$ (for the $\text{some } s$ case).

items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X) MvPolynomial.X) a
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $ and type $ S $, there exists an algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\text{Option } S] $ and the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[X][S] $. This equivalence is constructed by interpreting the 'none' variable as the indeterminate $ X $ in $ R[X] $, while mapping 'some $ i $' variables to the corresponding variables in $ S $. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, establishing a bijective correspondence between these two algebraic structures.
